limitations: All score and retrieval fixtures are synthetic; expected ranges and relevant_ids are hand-authored project test expectations, not human real annotations.
Offline evaluation makes no hosted-model calls and reports no Token counts or costs.
Default retrieval is local-hybrid only; BGE/Chroma reranking was not run and no BGE quality or latency is claimed.
BM25 and sparse_vector component Recall@k use actual helpers from the current local retriever; a separate dense-vector baseline is not measured in local mode.
Timings are local wall-clock perf_counter measurements and will vary between runs.
